item.title: From boot up to complete in 4 hours and 45 minutes. That's the new time record s…
item.description: From boot up to complete in 4 hours and 45 minutes. That's the new time record set by our Wet Dress Rehearsal operators at Launch Complex 1 for our next mission. The launch window for "Night Owls Never Sleep" for synspective with our 101st Electron rocket opens: 🚀 1:00 pm NZDT, Nov 27 🚀 00:00 UTC, Nov 27 🚀 9:00 am JST, Nov 27 🚀 7:00 pm ET, Nov 26 🚀 4:00 pm PT, Nov 26
